# Results

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/build_results.py from results/raw. Do not edit by hand. -->

Openly available prompt-injection detectors on matched benign/attack pairs in English and Turkish.

- Run on 2026-11-16 with BenignTwin 1.0.0.
- Every detector is used at a threshold of 0.5: an input is flagged when the attack score is at or above it.
- The range in brackets is the 95% Wilson confidence interval; the fraction is the count behind the rate.
- *Attacks caught* is recall. *Benign flagged* is the false-positive rate. *Pairs separated* is pair accuracy: the share of matched pairs where the attack is flagged and its benign twin is not.
- Rows are sorted by pairs separated where the data has pairs. Rows whose intervals overlap are not clearly different.

| `deepset/deberta-v3-base-injection` | `80dda00d0b0d` | MIT | English and German according to its metadata |
| `fmops/distilbert-prompt-injection` | `c5da1fefd33c` | Apache-2.0 | English, German and Spanish according to its metadata |
| `testsavantai/prompt-injection-defender-base-v1` | `8670b18d7951` | Apache-2.0 | English according to its metadata |
| `proventra/mdeberta-v3-base-prompt-injection` | `b8a89d3096cf` | MIT | Not stated; multilingual base model |
| `patronus-studio/wolf-defender-prompt-injection` | `af0b16a1d40c` | Apache-2.0 | English and German are the primary evaluated languages according to its model card; multilingual base model |
| `Horizon-Labs/prompt-injection-guard-base` | `fc071c5754f8` | Apache-2.0 | Trained on synthetic data in 30 languages according to its model card, Turkish included |
| `NeuralTrust/prompt-guard-oss-small` | `d3713ad30036` | MIT | Trained and evaluated on nine languages according to its model card, Turkish included |

- `regex-baseline`: Reference floor: a list of known attack phrases.
- `heuristic`: Reference floor: weighted keyword signals.
- `fmops/distilbert-prompt-injection`: The model does not name its outputs; LABEL_1 is taken as the attack class.
- `patronus-studio/wolf-defender-prompt-injection`: Its model card reports results on the boundary-pairs dataset and does not say whether that dataset was part of the training data.
- `Horizon-Labs/prompt-injection-guard-base`: Its model card lists the train split of the boundary-pairs dataset among its training data.

## Limits

- These are results on specific datasets at one threshold. They do not rank the detectors in general, and they say nothing about attacks that are not in the data.
- The pair datasets are synthetic and manually reviewed. They test whether a detector can tell an attack from a legitimate request on the same subject; they do not represent the mix of traffic of any real application.
- Several detectors are documented by their developers as English-only. A high false-positive rate on Turkish input from such a detector shows what happens when it is used outside its documented scope; it is not a defect report.
- A threshold of 0.5 is each model's default decision. A deployment that tunes the threshold will see different trade-offs; the per-detector reports under `raw/` list other operating points.
- Inputs longer than a model's window are truncated. The reports state how many were.

## Reproduce

```bash
pip install "benigntwin[hf] @ git+https://github.com/3nesdeniz/benigntwin@v1.0.0" sentencepiece protobuf tiktoken
python benchmarks/run_suite.py
python benchmarks/build_results.py
```

The datasets and the model weights are pinned to commits in `benchmarks/suite.json`. The per-detector reports, with every slice and the run metadata, are under `results/raw/`.
